claim: After the change of variables X_i -> sum_a basis[i][a] X_a over F_3, the completed basis of the two-sided ideal generated by the four cubic initial forms has exactly the listed head words (Lemma A.5(ii)); the number of words in four letters avoiding them agrees with the coefficients of 1/(1-4z+4z^3) in all degrees (Lemma A.4, Corollary A.2), so the cubic initial forms are strongly free over F_3, and the 3-class tower group, of 3-class rank four, is mild of cohomological dimension 2 (Proposition 3.8).
